notes.title: Controller UI improvements
notes.content: Small input improvements. When using a game controller, right stick now pans the view.

notes.title: Release 1.0.4 (minor update)
notes.content:
Adjusted the controller button mappings. (B/circle is now "cancel", which is the usual setup.)

Added an audio cue when a caption popup appears. (Selecting the "Library Closed" sign at night, for example.)

Slight translucency effect on the caption pop box. (Because why not.)

notes.title: Release 1.0.3 (minor update)
notes.content: Updated the Unity framework and some of the internal code. No user-visible changes.

notes.title: Leviathan works on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
I am pleased to report that [i]Leviathan[/i] works great on Steam Deck. (Not a surprise, since it's the same game engine as [i]Meanwhile[/i]!)

Left-stick to select a panel, A to advance. Menu button to bring up the menu. Or you can play directly on the touchscreen by tapping panels. That works too.

One possible wrinkle: I have a report(*) that sometimes Steam installs the [i]Windows[/i] version of the app on Steam Deck, rather than the Linux version.

If you find that the game dies on launch on Steam Deck, this is probably what's happened. If so, you can work around it by selecting "Properties", "Compatibility", check "Force the Use of Compatibility Tool", and then select "Steam Linux Runtime". This should force Steam to install the Linux version and then [i]Leviathan[/i] will run properly.

[* Okay, it was me. This happened to me. I have no idea why. But that's what I did to fix it.]

notes.title: Leviathan is out!
notes.content:
It's out! The latest interactive comic by Jason Shiga, author of Meanwhile.
